id_rule: The stable key is category + id. Do not rename an id. Add aliases when a source name must point at an existing id.
alias_policy: An alias belongs to one item. If a string is an id in one category and an alias in another, the category decides. Uncategorized {REASON:einstein} and the Sternberg panel mean construct/brainstorm. protium_level=einstein means protium/einstein (L8), not the brainstormer.

kwarg_map.mode: Forces mode/<id>. Wins over reasoning_effort. auto leaves the choice to the model.
kwarg_map.system: Forces pathway/<id> in {s1, s2, s3, auto}. A locked mode still picks its home pathway unless system is set.
kwarg_map.construct: Forces construct/<id>. Invalid values are ignored. reasoning_effort=mix with construct unset forces kitbash.
kwarg_map.persona: Forces persona/<id>. Invalid values are ignored. Default inhabited choice is neutral.
kwarg_map.identity: Forces identity/<id>. josie is accepted even though it is outside the v0.3 list. Invalid values are ignored. Default is none.
kwarg_map.theme: Forces theme/<id>. Invalid values are ignored. Default is none.
kwarg_map.aesthetic_preset: Forces aesthetic/<id>. Any non-empty string locks; known ids are the seven palettes.
kwarg_map.protium_level: Forces protium/<id>. Any non-empty string locks; known ids are the twelve levels. Inline [L0] and {REASON:} tags are not sniffed.

reasoning_effort.mix: mode auto, and construct kitbash when construct is unset
reasoning_effort.note: These kwargs are legacy aliases. They do not select reasoning_effort/effort_* . Native thinking_effort in the prompt is low on s1 and high on s2 or auto.

kwarg_map.enable_thinking: false forces thinking_effort off, even if reasoning_effort asked for depth.
